title: Module-Aware Optimization for Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2611.08379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Different optimizers impose different geometries on parameter updates. Adaptive methods such as Adam and AdamW use coordinate-wise updates, while matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon utilize weight-matrix structure through orthogonalized updates. For Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), however, the effective geometry of its weight matrices is shaped not only by its learned channel-mixing weights, but also by the graph-propagated representations it acts on. Thus, even if an update is well normalized as a matrix, its effect on the layer output can be amplified when applied to graph-propagated features. To address this gap, we introduce GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that adapts Muon's matrix updates to the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs. translated_title: 面向图神经网络的模块感知优化
translated_abstract: 不同的优化器对参数更新施加不同的几何结构。诸如Adam和AdamW之类的自适应方法采用逐坐标的更新方式，而诸如Muon之类的矩阵感知优化器则通过正交化更新来利用权重矩阵的结构。然而，对于图神经网络（GNN）而言，其权重矩阵的有效几何结构不仅由其学习到的通道混合权重所决定，还由其所作用的图传播表示所塑造。因此，即使某个更新作为矩阵已被很好地规范化，当其应用于图传播特征时，它对层输出的影响也可能被放大。为了弥补这一不足，我们提出了GraphMuon，一种图感知的优化器，它将Muon的矩阵更新适配到图传播层输入的协方差结构上。GraphMuon在这些传播表示所定义的度量空间中执行正交化，并根据更新对层表示产生的实际影响来规范化步长。
tldr: 提出了GraphMuon，一种图感知优化器，通过在图传播层输入的协方差结构所定义的度量下进行正交化并据此规范化步长，解决了现有矩阵优化器在训练图神经网络时忽略图传播表示几何结构、导致更新效果被放大的问题。
en_tdlr: We propose GraphMuon, a graph-aware optimizer that performs orthogonalization in a metric defined by the covariance structure of graph-propagated layer inputs and normalizes step sizes by their induced effect on layer representations, addressing the gap where existing matrix optimizers overlook the geometry of graph-propagated features in GNN training.
